slot.brief: Express one vector as a linear combination of the other two by equating components; solve the resulting simultaneous equations for the scalars.

stem: If $\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j$, $\vec b=3\hat i-\hat j$ and $\vec c=7\hat i$, then the scalars $m,n$ satisfying $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$ are

verdicts.working: Equating components gives m+3n=7 and 2m−n=0. Thus n=2m, so m=1 and n=2.

working:
$m+3n=7,\quad 2m-n=0$.
Thus $n=2m$, so $7m=7$ and $(m,n)=(1,2)$.
